integrity: Published Proposition 2.3 of arXiv:2210.10577 supplies the sequence recurrence; the new counting and growth argument is self-contained conditional on that established lemma. Bounded verification is supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Exact exponential rate and finite bounds are proved; no limiting prefactor, pointwise distribution, or assertion for all forbidden sets. No independent audit.
title: Exact exponential ambiguity rate for distance-two legal-index decompositions
